d: Village on the mouths of the river Amiso with huts of rednecks, illuminated by the moon in the hour towards dawn. Laodice with a few families, who draw from the fold a pigeon flock. It comes with a vase in hand from drawing water into the river.
Eupator, Antigono, who come from the sea with a palischelmo.
The royal hall in the palace of Sinope, ornamented for the anniversary solemnity in which the exaltation to the throne of the two tyrants is celebrated. Laodice, Stratonica.
Farnace, Stratonica, Laodice, Nicomede, Pelopida, with all the Court, Great of the Kingdom, and People.
Grand loggia of the royal palace, looking over the gardens, with door, where you enter the sumptuous apartments. Eupator, Antigono.
Apartment in the palace for the Ambassadors of Egypt. Antigono, Nicomede.
Courtyard ahead of the temple with altars, and set fires to make the public oath. Farnace, Pelopida, People, etc.
Farnace, Stratonica, Pelopida, Nicomede, Eupatore, Antigono, People, Court etc.
Farnace, Stratonica, Pelopida, People, Court etc.
Desert place, bordering on ruined factories, where the treasures of the ancient kings of Pontus are ascended. Laodice, and then Nicomede.
Laodice, Eupator, Antigon, Nicomede, Villani mat etc.

Beach of the sea, with all the army of Egypt, arranged in good order, to carry out the landing. Eupator descends with much pump; but with glowing signs, and causes one of his Captains to carry a sepulchral urn. Pelopida comes to receive him with the Comitiate, and Guards, in the name of the King, and of the Queen. Eupator, Pelopida, Laodice apart.
Part of the royal garden inside the palace of Sinope. Stratonic, Antigon, Laodice.
Forest not far from the city, and from the hotel, where the first ambassador of Egypt was held. Eupator, Pelopida, a Schiavo who carries the urn, in which the head of Mithridates was said closed.
Eupator, Laodice, Stratonic, Antigono, with a Captain, carrying a large disc covered with rich cloth.
The great square of Sinope before the royal palace. Eupator, already named for Mitridate, Antigono, already known for Issicratea, Laodice, Nicomede, Pelopida, Cortigiani, Soldati, People.
